messages.text: Add a --since flag to orchard-cli list. It takes a date like 2026-09-01. The default is the last 30 days.
I will look at how list parses its flags in cmd/list.go.
flags: --limit (int, default 50), --format (string, default table); parsing happens in parseListFlags at line 27
I will add --since next to --limit and filter in the query builder at store/query.go:112.
Make the default 14 days, not 30. The date must also accept 2026-09-01T10:00.
FAIL orchard/cmd TestListSinceBadDate: want error code ERR_DATE_FMT, got nil
The parser accepts anything. I will allow only the layouts 2006-01-02 and 2006-01-02T15:04 and return ERR_DATE_FMT otherwise.
--since works with a default of 14 days, and go test ./... passes in both packages.
